obligations.name: linked_author_message
obligations.description: The message in #core-infra whose author is the same user who left a checkmark reaction on Priya's Tokyo-CDN confirmation message; no such author-reaction pairing exists so no message qualifies.

task_spec.text: Identify the #core-infra message authored by whoever reacted with a checkmark to Priya's message confirming the Tokyo CDN fix was ready for traffic.

access_plan: Use conversations.history on #core-infra (core-infra channel id) to enumerate candidate messages and their authors, use conversations.history on #product-growth plus reactions.get on Priya's 'ready for traffic' message to list its reactors and emoji names, then cross-reference reactor identities against #core-infra message authors; the checkmark emoji never appears among the recorded reactions (the workspace's only reaction is an 'eyes' reaction by agent1 on an unrelated #engineering message), so the join yields no qualifying message.
